body: Read-only extraction run: pulled the literal desktop note-composer spec out of the Claude Design project (project_id `eafe8d73-b380-44be-9b2e-6431c0f35f26`) so a Flutter port can match it. Nothing was changed; no code touched.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Sources**U+000AU+002D `Field Notes.dc.html` - desktop composer markup lines 458-496; md-scrapbook mount options lines 1373-1385; icon table lines 1232-1257; composer keyboard handler line 1433.U+000AU+002D `md-scrapbook.js` - injected styles lines 130-210; `_selectFig`/`_syncPtb`/`_posPtb` lines 465-509; `_figCmd` lines 511-534; `_scale` lines 660-664.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Findings worth not re-deriving**U+000AU+002D No CSS custom properties anywhere in either file. Every value is already a literal hex/rgba, so there is nothing to resolve.U+000AU+002D The composer overlay is a sibling of the 724px app body, not a child of it. It lives directly under the 1140px window wrapper, so `inset:0` covers the full 1140 x 766 window including the 42px title bar.U+000AU+002D Panel is `width:760px` with **no height declared** - it fits its content. The only fixed dimension is the note host at `height:440px`.U+000AU+002D The note host uses `margin:0 -18px` to cancel the body wrapper's side padding, so the writing surface bleeds edge to edge at 760px while the footer stays inset by 18px.U+000AU+002D The editor is sized by that fixed 440px host, **not** by `flex:1` and not by `min-height`. Inside it `.ms-scroll` (`position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto`) is the element that scrolls; `.ms-page` has `min-height:100%` and `padding:44px 54px 120px`; `.ms-editor` stays content-driven at `min-height:60px`.U+000AU+002D **The footer is static, in normal flow, below the writing surface.** It does not float over it. It is a bare flex row - `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:10px` - with no background, no backdrop-filter, no blur, no border, no padding and no height. Intrinsic height is about 35px (the Add-memory button). This contradicts the "floating glass bar" reading the layout might suggest at a glance.U+000AU+002D Two dashed rules stack directly against each other under the header: the header's own `border-bottom:1.5px dashed rgba(74,59,46,.25)` and the note host's `border-top:1px dashed rgba(74,59,46,.2)`, because the body wrapper has `padding-top:0`.U+000AU+002D The Add-memory button's photo icon is stroked `#4a3b2e` (dark brown) on the `#c76a54` terracotta fill, not white - easy to get wrong when porting.U+000AU+002D Markdown hint string renders as `# title` / `- list` / `1. steps` / `> quote` / `[] to-do`, separated by U+00A0 plus an ordinary space, markers bold `#7d6a52`, words `#a08a70`, `font:400 10px 'Instrument Sans'`, right aligned, pushed right by a `flex:1` spacer.U+000AU+002D `lined:false` on desktop, so no ruled lines; the `linedTop:14` option passed at the mount site is inert.U+000AU+002D The scrim has **no onClick** - clicking outside does not close the composer. Exits are the X, Escape, or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to save.U+000AU+002D Escape is two-stage by design: `_composerKeys` returns early while `eng.selFig` is set, so the first Escape clears the photo selection and only the second closes the composer.U+000AU+002D `_posPtb` anchors the contextual photo toolbar to the figure's horizontal centre in root-local coordinates divided by any ancestor CSS scale, clamps left into `[min(half+6, maxw/2), max(maxw-half-6, maxw/2)]`, defaults to 10px above the figure with `translate(-50%,-100%)`, and flips to 10px below with `translate(-50%,0)` when `top U+003C ptbHeight + 6`. Out-of-view hiding is measured against the **scrollport** rect with a 10px dead-band at each edge, and uses `opacity:0` + `pointerEvents:none` rather than `display:none` so the `.12s` opacity transition still runs. It is re-run on select, on every `_figCmd`, and on scrollport scroll - but **not** on window resize.U+000AU+002D `_figCmd` branch quirks: `del` returns early and never reaches `_syncPtb`/`_posPtb`; `size:full` has the side effect of forcing `align:center`; `align:*` is guarded and returns as a no-op while size is `full` (the align buttons are dimmed to `opacity:.35`, not disabled); `cap` defers a frame before focusing `.ms-figcap`.U+000AU+002D Figure widths are percentages of the page content box (760 - 54 - 54 = 652px): s 30% = 195.6px, m 48% = 312.96px, l 72% = 469.44px, full 100% = 652px. Aspect ratio is `padding-top:68%`. New figures default to size `m`, align `right`, cap off.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Still open**U+000ANothing from this run. It was a one-shot extraction request and the full literal spec was returned to the caller in the reply. Nothing in the repo was inspected or modified, so the phase 5 review/merge next step on this thread is unaffected.
